name: EKO 4K Android TV (bangbae, MTC, MediaTek)
warnings: Never launch either. mediatek.factorymenu.ui has a LAUNCHER entry on this firmware, so it is reachable from the app grid; hide it with hidden_apps rather than disabling it. - com.airoha.btd: the Bluetooth remote's firmware updater, shown as "RemoteOTA". - com.mediatek.tvinput, com.mediatek.tv.service, com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter (Live TV).
On this TV it owned one saved network but not the one in use, so it was safe to leave alone; it is not in this list either way.
